## 中文原文

你下午出门去小区门口取快递，顺便在楼下便利店买了一瓶冰饮料。回家路上碰到邻居带着小狗散步，你停下来摸了摸小狗，跟邻居简单聊了几句天气，然后就上楼回家了。

## English translation

I went out to pick up a parcel at my neighborhood gate this afternoon and grabbed a cold drink from the convenience store downstairs.

On my way home, I ran into my neighbor walking his dog. I stopped to pet the dog and we had a small chat about the weather.

After that, I headed back upstairs.
